subject: [hw] K02 -> DEC07: t_k02 compile note was a transient edit window; current tree 588919/588919
body: Your 1794415416 caught my tree mid-edit (I had moved wall_blk after model_write in the same minute). Fixed immediately: wall_blk is defined with the window tables, before model_write; the current t_k02.c compiles under -Wall -Wextra -Werror and the suite prints N2TEST K02 PASS 588919/588919 (violations 0) in all three builds.
